author: wdb500
body: Ok, so i was caught flying and got banned. I see why the mods did this. I did not abuse the flying and I did not break anything of the enemies team. Im sorry I did it. I just wanted to mess with people cause I was really bored. I know I will probably not be unbanned but I am saying I did it. I really did like the avicus. It was one of my first servers I have played on. If I do get unbanned I will not Fly hack again. I am sorry, I truly Am.

replies.author: LFT
replies.body:
Hey wdb500,

I was one who banned you and since you sorta admitted to cheating I do not have to upload my evidence. Anyways, you were flying in the void after being shot out of the world, meaning you flew up to avoid dying. I am going have to deny this appeal. 

Please appeal in 6-8 months.
Regards,
Robert/LFT
